nrde01.title: Aries plans ice skating at 7 AM
nrde01.caption:
Would you go ice skating at 7 AM for someone?
Aries did laps. The date held the wall. Then Aries came back for their hand.

nrde02.title: Taurus plans a soup crawl
nrde02.caption:
Four soups in one night: dream date or too much?
Taurus saw their date was full and packed the rest to go. No fuss.

nrde03.title: Gemini plans a bookshop swap
nrde03.caption:
You each pick a book for the other. What would yours be?
Gemini picked nine. Their date picked one, and it was perfect.

nrde04.title: Cancer builds a pillow fort
nrde04.caption:
A pillow fort, two mugs and one long talk. Yes or no?
The fort fell in on them. The talk kept going anyway.

nrde05.title: Leo judges a gingerbread contest
nrde05.caption:
Would you let a Leo judge your gingerbread house?
Leo built a castle, then gave the crown to the lopsided little house.

nrde06.title: Virgo plans a spontaneous day
nrde06.caption:
Can a spontaneous day come with an itinerary?
Virgo crossed out the plan the moment their date spotted a cosy café.
